name: Blast Proof
description:
After enough time dealing with explosions, you've made sure your armor can deal with some the impacts.
When you would take fire or bludgeoning damage from an area effect, treat your armors resistance as double the listed amount

name: Jump Jets
description:
Once per turn you can use an action to fly 3 steps, falling if you are still in the air after the movement.
You can use this ability up three times per day
